ambient_events: The sealed door hums faintly, as if something behind it still draws power.
A keypad beside the frame is dark, its casing cracked but intact.
Cold, machine-scented air seeps under the door's bottom edge.
description: The gallery narrows to a landing before a heavy steel maintenance door, set deep in a reinforced frame and streaked with old rust-weep. A dead keypad guards it. Whatever lies beyond has been sealed off from the sewer for a long time, and unlike the rest of the Under, it still smells faintly of clean, cold machinery. It will not open for you today.
name: Sealed Maintenance Door
